description: This file defines a React component called ChatWindow, which manages a chat interface in a frontend application. It handles session creation, message display, user input, and communication with a backend API for chat messages. The component maintains state for messages, input, loading status, and session ID, and implements side effects for initializing sessions and auto-scrolling.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Handles sending a user message to the backend API and updates the chat with the assistant's response.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events to send the message when Enter is pressed (excluding Shift+Enter for new lines).
